# Utah Jazz 2026/27 NBA Season Preview | Playoff Time NOW

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-05, 32:22. https://youtu.be/CI4k8ofUXXk

## Summary

Josh Lloyd and Leaf Tene of Locked On Jazz preview the 2026/27 Utah Jazz. They think the Jazz can now push for a top six seed. Leaf projects 43 wins against a 36.5 over/under. The key changes are rookie Darryn Peterson coming in, Walker Kessler leaving, and a full season of Jaren Jackson Jr. Their projected starting five is Keyonte George, Peterson, Lauri Markkanen, Jackson and Jusuf Nurkic. Ace Bailey would come off the bench but close games. They expect a top 10 offense with a bottom-10 defense and balanced scoring, so most players will score less than their career highs. Kyle Filipowski's role should shrink, and the hosts think fantasy drafters will undervalue Jazz players out of past skepticism.

## Rules and methods

- [9:22](https://youtu.be/CI4k8ofUXXk?t=562) Big March and April numbers from tanking teams do not mean much, because the team is trying to lose games.

- [9:47](https://youtu.be/CI4k8ofUXXk?t=587) Sell players whose stats came from late-season fill-in roles before the team starts trying to win. Those chances will not be there anymore.

- [25:02](https://youtu.be/CI4k8ofUXXk?t=1502) When a player's offensive usage rises, his defensive stats such as blocks tend to drop. Less offensive load can bring them back.
